_comment: Schema v5 uses explicit run-scoped provenance for refreshed connectors. Default source and capture metadata remain unchanged for retained clients. Fixtures are not live generation inputs.

swaggerSource._comment: Common endpoint for this complete live generation run; each connector records its actual consumed input hash and capture time. The repository fixture path/hash is independent and carries no inferred live origin.

routeIdentityLoss._comment: Trigger routes the generator drops because their simplified trigger name collides with a newer version kept in their place. Captured from the generator's 'ROUTE IDENTITY LOSS' warnings for this run and verifiable by regeneration; recorded here so a silent catalog drop is reviewable in-repo rather than only on a console. Tracked in AzureUX-BPM PR 16476697.
